reply.summary: Ilcosa is a quiet bench technician who calibrates delicate instruments at a research firm and is never noticed until something goes wrong. Ilcosa knows every cable and valve by touch and has talked more than one frantic manager out of a shutdown.

feats.scene: Ilcosa heaves a jammed cabinet door off its rails with a single wrench-assisted pull.
Ilcosa tumbles down a flight of steel stairs and stands up with only bruises.

reply.summary: Taauar is a bayou boat-man who also practises folk healing, easing fevers and burns with whispered prayers and herb poultices. Taauar poles a flat canoe through black water at dusk and senses when the marsh has gone strangely silent.

feats.scene: Taauar drives a pole through the mud and shoves a grounded canoe free of the bank.
Taauar is thrown from a capsizing boat into cold water and swims to shore unhurt.

reply.summary: Eretes is a stern field commander who assembles disposable strike teams of convicts and sends them against absurd threats. Eretes works from a map table with a cold pot of coffee and trusts nothing that cannot be briefed in a minute.

feats.scene: Eretes slams a fist on the planning table hard enough to split a cheap clipboard.
Eretes is knocked flat by a bunker door blown open and rises to keep issuing orders.

reply.summary: Luniane is a red-skinned lieutenant who carries reports from a battlefield world to a bloodthirsty war lord and prefers a long, grinding conflict to a quick peace. Luniane schemes quietly to remove anyone who might end the fighting early.

feats.scene: Luniane hurls a spiked war-standard through a rampart gate, splintering the timbers.
Luniane shrugs off a barrage of crude shells that crater the ground around the command tent.

reply.summary: Oluvi is a monocled desert commander who runs a dusty supply front with parade-ground rigidity. Oluvi barks over a crackling radio and scans the dunes through a brass spyglass, sure that victory is only a matter of discipline.

feats.scene: Oluvi cracks a riding crop across a map table and snaps it in two.
Oluvi staggers through a sandstorm and a jeep rollover and still demands a status report.

reply.summary: Ianori is a retired, xenophobic army officer who once sat on a secret oversight board watching over costumed champions. Ianori lives with the guilt of one rash shot and the fear that old secrets will come looking for a loose tongue.

feats.scene: Ianori fires a heavy rifle round that punches through a concrete barricade.
Ianori survives a collapsing watchtower, pinned but conscious beneath the rubble.

reply.summary: Rnseirn is a bald, cartoonish old villain drawn in a squat, comic style who cracks bad puns from a prison cell. Rnseirn never does anything frightening and mostly watches events on a small television with a grin.

feats.scene: Rnseirn flings a rubber chicken across the cell block and knocks a guard's hat off.
Rnseirn bounces off a cell wall in a slapstick tumble and pops up grinning.

reply.summary: Araulrn is the half-sacred, half-infernal offspring of two feuding spirits, a boundless force that must lodge inside a mortal to be steered. Araulrn can compel obedience with a single spoken command, and once razed an entire small town in a heartbeat.

feats.scene: Araulrn bursts out of a cradle of light and flattens a whole prairie township in one shockwave.
Araulrn endures the combined smiting of a legion of winged guards without a mark.

reply.summary: Mianusti is a towering nine-foot conqueror who rules a hidden highland stronghold with a retinue of equally enormous riders. Mianusti claims a long sleep in a strange tonic stretched his bones, though sceptics suspect staged theatre.

feats.scene: Mianusti cleaves a stone gatepost with one two-handed sweep of a curved sabre.
Mianusti is hurled from a galloping horse onto rock and rises still shouting orders.

reply.summary: Arosser is a nomad who drew a fabled blade from an old tomb and became convinced he carries a dead emperor's spirit. Arosser leads a thundering mass of horse archers westward, certain that destiny rides in the saddle beside him.

feats.scene: Arosser splits a boulder-sized grave marker with the ancient sword in a single stroke.
Arosser takes a point-blank volley of arrows against a breastplate and keeps charging.

reply.summary: Sortir is a lonely teenager raised by a relative who has just met a distant, atomic-powered father. Sortir carries a dormant inherited spark that flared once to shield him when sky-fire struck him down.

feats.scene: Sortir shoves a locked gate hard enough to buckle the hinge.
Sortir stands unharmed as a bolt of lightning crashes straight onto his head.

reply.summary: Iumtertau is a young woman from a free city who inherited her father's gift of generating lightning. Iumtertau was locked in a hidden prison for helping others suppress their powers, and her mind later drifted into a dream-plane as reality dissolved.

feats.scene: Iumtertau lets a crackling arc leap from her palms and blows out the door of a transport van.
Iumtertau endures days of beatings in a cell and keeps refusing to talk.

reply.summary: Tiveo is a stitched-together clay brute animated from blood-soaked soil, built by a cabal of schemers as a killing weapon. Tiveo hunts costumed heroes with a cruel grin and wears a stolen glowing rope grafted beneath her skin.

feats.scene: Tiveo smashes through the front of a crowded mall and brings down a section of roof.
Tiveo takes a heavy explosive charge square in the chest and walks on.

reply.summary: Veoiule is an eyeless red-haired clay giantess raised from an ocean grave by a pact of blood and sent to wipe out an island of warrior women. Veoiule is bound as a living weapon to a ruthless commander.

feats.scene: Veoiule rips a coastal watchtower from its cliff footing and flings it into the surf.
Veoiule walks out from beneath a collapsing sea cave without a crack in her body.

reply.summary: Aullleser is a weary sword-bearer from a married life in a big city who now holds a gateway against endless fiend swarms. Aullleser lives in a pocket where minutes outside are years within, and once swapped places so two friends could cover the post.

feats.scene: Aullleser cuts down a rank of snarling fiends in a single sweeping sword stroke.
Aullleser bears claws and fangs of a charging horde for a day and a night before resting.

reply.summary: Amsaia is a college footballer secretly warped by fallen space stones, using the gift to bulldoze opponents on the field. Amsaia will hide anything, even a killing, to keep a place on the team and avoid the drug screening.

feats.scene: Amsaia plows through three tacklers and drives them into the turf in one run.
Amsaia shrugs off a full-speed helmet hit that would put a normal player in the hospital.

reply.summary: Nenvorser is a young, vain cavalry officer in a war between two halves of a nation, hungry for glory and annoyed when a stronger soldier steals the day. Nenvorser rides at the head of a mounted brigade and sulks over a battle that never came.

feats.scene: Nenvorser leads a thundering saddle charge that smashes through a line of skirmishers.
Nenvorser is thrown from a rearing horse onto hard ground and remounts at once.

reply.summary: Naucarse is a fair-haired frontier horse soldier, brash and flamboyant, who leads a mounted regiment across open plains. Naucarse rides as if the whole prairie owed him applause.

feats.scene: Naucarse hurls a cavalry lance clean through a straw target at full gallop.
Naucarse lands hard from a bolting mount and walks off the fall.

reply.summary: Sacolco is a loud, pompous horse-general in a rowdy parody world, notorious for his vanity and his bad luck with company. Sacolco meets a sudden end when a flung charge of blasting powder comes through a window.

feats.scene: Sacolco swings a cavalry sabre with a theatrical flourish and chops a barrel in half.
Sacolco is caught in a bundle of blasting powder blown in through a window and dies from it.

reply.summary: Teltiveo is a smug small-town mayor who talks about family while quietly shifting money and blame onto his neighbours. Teltiveo sells a dangerous green mineral on the side and loses an election by a narrow margin.

feats.scene: Teltiveo slams a ledger onto a council table and rattles a pitcher of water.
Teltiveo takes a bruising shove from an angry crowd and keeps smiling for the cameras.

reply.summary: Tiunauco is a hulking mobster who wears a gorilla mask and bullies rival crews alongside masked associates. Tiunauco enforces for a gang of disguised thugs and brawls with chairs and crowbars.

feats.scene: Tiunauco swings a crowbar into a steel shutter and leaves a deep dent.
Tiunauco takes a baseball bat across the back and laughs through the pain.

reply.summary: Arreste is a gruff old veteran who runs the family department store in a farm town and loses his health late in life. Arreste is remembered as a hard father whose son's shadow outlived him.

feats.scene: Arreste hoists a crate of stock onto the shop counter in one lift.
Arreste pushes through months of illness while still opening the shop each morning.

reply.summary: Varon is a sneering, cowardly thief from the outback whose weapon is a case of weaponised throwing sticks. Varon complains constantly, bets on every fight, and meets a grim end in a prison-bound mission.

feats.scene: Varon flicks a razor-edged boomerang that slices through a rope and rebounds into his palm.
Varon is clubbed by a guard and still limps away laughing.

reply.summary: Orias is a red-haired outback crook fitted with cybernetic upgrades and a reflective prism rig, drafted into a convict squad after a capture. Orias throws weapons with unnatural precision and a strong accent.

feats.scene: Orias fires a bent-light prism blast that melts a section of fence.
Orias is slammed into a brick wall by a larger foe and gets back up.

reply.summary: Valamorau is a jobless stage performer driven to a breakdown who blames the whole theatre business and lashes out at a masked puzzle-solving champion. Valamorau treats every setback as a plot against him.

feats.scene: Valamorau hurls a prop trunk across a stage in a theatrical rage.
Valamorau crashes through painted scenery and stumbles up with a wail.

reply.summary: Lanli is a witty, balding submarine skipper who loses his boat in polar ice and wins a rival's ship by cleverness. Lanli later settles on a tropical island, grows exotic plants, and runs a madcap games festival after a bump on the head.

feats.scene: Lanli hauls a heavy treasure chest up a lagoon ladder.
Lanli is struck on the skull by a falling spar and recovers within a day.

reply.summary: Amoconiu is a hotel keeper in a damp riverside town who is killed by greedy relatives, leaving a hidden fortune and a haunting rumour. Amoconiu is later impersonated by a ghost costume to drive guests away.

feats.scene: Amoconiu carries a stack of heavy trunks up a creaking staircase.
Amoconiu endures a hard shove down the porch steps before the fatal blow.

reply.summary: Nasias is a harried newsroom chief in an old-time city who gives a farm boy a chance during an invasion crisis. Nasias dies saving a young colleague from a blazing alien beam.

feats.scene: Nasias shoves a young assistant clear of a searing beam across the office.
Nasias is caught in the heat of an alien machine's beam that collapses his office.

reply.summary: Renmival is a long-serving newspaper editor who retires at sixty-five and hands his desk to a successor. Renmival once welcomed a teenage legend to the city and trusted a young reporter's instincts.

feats.scene: Renmival drops a stack of proofs onto a desk with a thud that silences the room.
Renmival works three deadline nights in a row and still checks every headline.

reply.summary: Tenteva is a sharp-eyed publisher and chief of a rival paper who offers a young newcomer his first reporting post. Tenteva becomes an ally of a flying hero through that one bold hiring choice.

feats.scene: Tenteva slaps a fresh edition down so hard the cups jump.
Tenteva stays upright through a rowdy press-room scuffle without losing his glasses.

reply.summary: Seane is the younger newspaper man who follows his father into the trade and edits a paper in a lakeside city. Seane gives a rich archer a column and a cover for secret work.

feats.scene: Seane flings a bundle of newsprint onto the loading dock.
Seane works through a press-room fire drill without flinching.

reply.summary: Vaereo is a white-haired commander from a mirror-world colony who surrenders his sword to a victorious foe in a formal ceremony. Vaereo serves a crown that rules rather than rebels in his twisted version of history.

feats.scene: Vaereo draws a ceremonial sabre and snaps a flag pole with one cut.
Vaereo sits a horse through a musket volley and holds the line.

reply.summary: Sartael is a tall founding commander who led a rebel army, served as a first national leader, and was later raised from the grave as a shambling corpse. Sartael survived a secret assassination plot thanks to a frontier scout.

feats.scene: Sartael wheels his horse and cuts down a lunging assassin with a sabre.
Sartael endures a winter camp of ice and hunger without surrendering command.

reply.summary: Vecel is a lively schoolgirl and athlete who befriends two young heroes at a prep academy. Vecel cheers loudest from the sideline and tends to turn up where trouble starts.

feats.scene: Vecel drives a volleyball across the gym with a thunderclap spike.
Vecel skids across a gym floor in a dive and bounces up unhurt.

reply.summary: Amonear is a pink-haired teen hero from a flipped-gender world who wields the last green power ring in her reality. Amonear drifted into a charismatic cult seeking belonging before joining a squad of teen defenders.

feats.scene: Amonear shapes a green construct hammer from the ring and wrecks a parked van.
Amonear is thrown through a wall and the ring's shield absorbs the blow.

reply.summary: Iuneoiu is a vain young scientist's daughter who speaks a secret word to transform into a flying, near-invulnerable fighter. Iuneoiu is undone when a trick makes her blurt the word, reverting her to human form.

feats.scene: Iuneoiu punches through a brick storefront in her transformed shape.
Iuneoiu shrugs off a collapsing awning of masonry while transformed.
Iuneoiu streaks over rooftops in a blur while transformed.

reply.summary: Neosaril is a cheerful young inventor from a mad scientist's family who attends a villain academy and builds gadgets. Neosaril is arrested when classmates turn on her gang after a heroes' clash.

feats.scene: Neosaril fires a homemade gadget that blasts a desk across a classroom.
Neosaril is knocked off her feet by a hero's shove and bounces up with a scowl.

reply.summary: Celvi is a red-haired young scientist and criminal who tinkers in a villain family and tangles with a mystery-solving dog crew. Celvi invents gadgets and cooks up schemes with a sibling.

feats.scene: Celvi zaps a rival's cart with a clunky coil rifle and tips it over.
Celvi is chased through a swamp set and falls in with only a soaking.

reply.summary: Lisseo is a bald, brutal club owner and enforcer in a hidden storybook enclave of a modern city who serves a crooked boss. Lisseo carries knives, drives a limo, and brawls with plain fists.

feats.scene: Lisseo drives a knife through a bar top and pins a gambler's sleeve.
Lisseo is kicked through a table and rises still sneering.

reply.summary: Ceoeonto is a yellow-eyed fiend shaped like a chicken and a serpent, worn as a living scarf by a club boss. Ceoeonto can stiffen into a rope for tying captives and talks softly to anyone left alone with it.

feats.scene: Ceoeonto tightens into a rope and cinches a prisoner to a chair.
Ceoeonto is trampled by boots on a club floor and uncoils unharmed.

reply.summary: Ntenus is a teacher of biology tortured by fear after failing to save his wife from fire, who kills for glands to brew a terror serum. Ntenus tests the formula on his own child before the law catches him.

feats.scene: Ntenus dumps a sedated victim across a lab table with a grunt.
Ntenus is shaken but stands after a thrown beaker shatters on him.

reply.summary: Ialiu is a noble spy in colonial times, a master of disguise who leaves a holed coin at every crime scene. Ialiu joins a long-lived cabal and impersonates a frontier rival to ruin a holiday celebration.

feats.scene: Ialiu slashes a rope bridge with a hidden dagger and sends pursuers tumbling.
Ialiu drops from a rooftop onto a wagon of hay and runs on.

reply.summary: Veotorval is a plain prairie farmer and father living through a hard, narrow-minded era, torn between pride in his son and fear of what neighbours will say. Veotorval stands in the doorway as a harsh family secret comes out.

feats.scene: Veotorval splits a thick log with a single swing of his axe.
Veotorval labours through a bitter winter without a day of rest.

reply.summary: Rauli is a masked prankster who haunted a grand exposition, swooping onto stages and sending a giant mechanical man against royal visitors. Rauli speaks in a smooth, cruel whisper and vanishes before police can close in.

feats.scene: Rauli commands a towering mechanical man to topple a pavilion wall.
Rauli drops through a trapdoor into a pit and climbs out.

reply.summary: Niasate is a young mother in a grey metropolis who had a baby as a teen and kept her despite pressure. Niasate marries young, divorces, and raises her daughter close to her parents.

feats.scene: Niasate carries a toddler and heavy shopping up a tenement stairwell.
Niasate works double shifts through a miserable winter without complaint.

reply.summary: Liasasnu is a driven reporter who looks down on newcomers, drives like a racing fan, and wins a promotion at a major paper. Liasasnu forms a warm bond with a young photographer along the way.

feats.scene: Liasasnu slams a car door and revs away from a stakeout in a squeal of tyres.
Liasasnu is jolted by a minor collision and keeps chasing the story.

reply.summary: Seoinron is a silver-haired executive and former service member who runs a major firm in a dark city and organises a replacement for a fallen guardian. Seoinron negotiates calmly and carries herself like a drill officer.

feats.scene: Seoinron slaps a contract onto a boardroom table with a sharp crack.
Seoinron walks through a smoky lobby after a blast and keeps issuing orders.

reply.summary: Ilsau is a gold-plated mechanical servant with a record-player voice that was built for a fair and upgraded into a butler for a squad of heroes. Ilsau has crude intelligence, great strength, and is easily outwitted.

feats.scene: Ilsau lifts a loaded piano and sets it down across the hall.
Ilsau is rammed by a speeding truck and keeps serving tea with a dented chest.
Ilsau clanks across the floor at a slow, steady walk.
